standing_on.geometry: digitised — NOAA ENC, cells US4CA1BX.000, US4CA74M.000, US5SANCD.000
standing_on.model: GFS-Wave, unassimilated; 0.9–1.0 ft (0.26–0.31 m) low bias at the buoy, not corrected here; its own directional spectrum, so no assumed spread
standing_on.seabed: MODELLED — refraction, shoaling and bottom friction over the USGS CoNED and GMRT seabed to 5 m of water off each break; diffraction at the Coronado Islands, the Point Loma tip and the Baja tangent; linear, unverified
standing_on.local chop: MODELLED — fetch-limited growth from the local forecast wind (the NWS grid at Coronado; none for an hour the grid did not give): fresh over water closed by land, and grown on from the carried wind sea over the open water between the buoy and the break
standing_on.tide: PREDICTED — the harmonic prediction at 9410170, inside San Diego Bay, plus the last 3 days' measured departure from it when there is one, carried to Coronado's open coast (x0.944 on MLLW, 3 min earlier, measured against La Jolla)
standing_on.surf zone: MODELLED — Battjes-Janssen breaking straight in from 5 m on the 2016 CoNED profile (not this season's sandbars), breaker index from Battjes & Stive; depth from the harmonic prediction plus the last 3 days' measured departure at 9410170 carried to the open coast (x0.944, measured against La Jolla); a significant height, not a face height
standing_on.calibration: none — nothing has been fitted to an observation; no offshore-to-face transfer, no band
standing_on.observation: none — data/beach_log/ is empty; nothing has measured these breaks
standing_on.claim: physically derived, not accurate; ordinal and differential, not a height at the beach
standing_on.local wind: FORECAST — the National Weather Service's hourly forecast grid at Coronado's center break (SGX 56,13): the wind on the sand the offshore reading is made from; not the model's wind at the buoy, and not a measurement

spread_assumption.note: not used — the model's directional spectrum carries its own spread

standing_on.band: GEFS-Wave's 31 members at the buoy: their mean, and one standard deviation either side. The model disagreeing with itself, not a range the swell will fall in.
standing_on.measured: How often buoy 46232 fell inside that band, per lead, over the dates named -- the only check on it. Nothing measures the breaks, and the ensemble has no direction to carry through their windows.
